learning_extracted: The seed-dependent 'divergence' (seeds 42/123 conv_rel_drop -2.29/-0.47) is substantially an artifact of the convergence GATE: conv_rel_drop is built from episode-rollout PE on a free-running agent, so episode-to-episode exploration/coverage drift inflates the late-episode PE while the init-PE denominator varies 8.7x; final PE clusters within ~2x across seeds (the model ends in the same place; the metric can't see it).

The recon-anchor fix (the 701 prescription) is genuinely working where measurable: seed456 converged cleanly (conv_rel_drop +0.80), which 701 never achieved (run-level mean -2.60). The fix direction was right; the residual is the convergence-certification instrument + 2/3-seed stability, not the recon objective.

On the one valid converged seed, R1=-0.55 (novelty LOWERS PE) and C1 flat -- a first glimpse of a possible MEL ceiling -- but n=1 ready seed filtered by a confounded gate is too thin to certify. A frozen-probe-metric 701b that certifies convergence honestly across seeds is the decisive test; only an R2-passing multi-seed flat-MEL result, OR a genuine frozen-metric multi-seed divergence, resolves INV-050 MEL-measurability either way.
